about_the_game:
Trapped in a forgotten valley, you and your group must survive the horrors lurking beneath the lake.

To make it out alive, you’ll need to gather bait, fish relentlessly, and offer your catch to an ancient altar. Fail to feed the lake in time, and the thing beneath the surface will rise.

GONE Fishing is a 1–4 player co-op survival horror game where your group works together to keep an unknowable terror at bay by:

  • Scavenging the forest and environment for bait

  • Fishing in the cursed lake for fish

  • Offering fish as ritual tributes to prevent the creature’s awakening

  • Surviving as the game grows more intense the longer you play

Can you keep the hunger satisfied... or will you be the next meal?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror elements, mild blood effects, and tense survival scenarios. Players may encounter unsettling imagery, fear-based events, and the suggestion of violent death at the hands of a monstrous entity. The atmosphere is intentionally dark and intense, with a focus on psychological tension.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: GONE Fishing is a co-op multiplayer survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?
